limitations: All declared cfg/optional path dependencies and source branches are conservatively observed, not resolved compiler features.
Only selected-root dev dependencies are selected; dependency package test modules are conservatively extra source observations, not executed suites.
Literal fixture macros resolve relative to their actual owning Cargo manifest; literal include macros resolve relative to their source file.

Inline module directory contexts, computed paths/proc-macro output and registry/git/patch resolution remain owned by canonical Cargo Source/dependency admission; unresolved literals are explicit, never silently counted resolved.
